reports.title: Sarah Chappell: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: There was a ten day delay in Ms [name redacted] transfer from the Princess Royal Hospital to UCLH
the consultant urology surgeon in charge of Ms [name redacted] care was very firmly of the view that he was not the best clinician to fulfil this role

Despite the agreement on 16 June of the gastroenterology clinical director that Ms [name redacted] care should be led by the gastroenterologists, they had not taken over her care by the time of her death,
There was a frequent misunderstanding among the medical staff that Ms [name redacted] issues were all chronic
the pain relief offered to Ms Chappell (principally simply paracetamol) was completely inadequate
The management of the nasogastric tube that was crucial in attempting to avoid a fatal aspiration was inappropriate
